It reflects Saudi Arabia’s strategic role in strengthening maritime stability and supporting a sustainable global economy.

Seabed Security and Maritime Supply Chains in a Critically Changing World

The infrastructure beneath the world’s oceans supports global communication, energy transportation, trade, defence, and economic stability. As geopolitical tensions, cyber threats, technological change, and supply-chain disruption increase, its protection has become a strategic international priority.

Subsea cables, pipelines, energy routes, data networks, ports, and maritime logistics systems form a critical part of the global economy. Disruption can affect governments, businesses, financial markets, energy systems, and public services.
Undersea systems have become essential to global economic, energy, defence, and digital continuity.
Physical security and cybersecurity must be addressed together across shared maritime systems.
Advanced sensors, autonomous systems, artificial intelligence, monitoring, and data analysis will play a growing role.
Ports, logistics networks, energy routes, and international trade require coordinated planning and resilient operations.
Defence, government, industry, and research communities must collaborate to protect infrastructure that crosses jurisdictions.
Saudi Arabia connects vital energy routes, trade corridors, ports, infrastructure, and international maritime interests.

In a proud continuation of its role in national ceremonial excellence, Startime once again took part in organizing the prestigious graduation ceremony of King Khalid Military College, held in May 2024 under the honor of His Royal Highness Prince Abdullah bin Bandar bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Minister of the National Guard; The event marked the graduation of the 35th University Officer Qualification Course and the 40th cohort of cadets, in a solemn and patriotic occasion that honored both achievement and sacrifice. Among the graduates were ten sons of fallen heroes from the Ministry of Defense, the National Guard, and the Ministry of Interior, an initiative by the National Guard to recognize the legacy of those who gave their lives in defense of the nation and to empower their children to follow in their footsteps.

The ceremony commenced with the royal anthem and a recitation from the Holy Qur'an, followed by a keynote address from the College Commander, who expressed deep appreciation for the Minister’s patronage and pride in the graduating class; he emphasized that this cohort represents a new generation of officers who have completed rigorous academic and military training, and are now prepared to serve with honor and distinction in a nation that continues to lead globally in development and progress.

In a move that reflects Saudi Arabia's ambition to establish itself as a global sports destination, Startime has signed an international sports agreement with UK-based Onlydo Events to host a three-year series of Football Legends Tours, with the first tour set to launch in January 2026, featuring a historic match between England and Brazil Legends; the signing ceremony took place at the Startime headquarters in Riyadh, in the presence of the Startime Founder and CEO Shaya Al Kahtani, Onlydo Events’ Founder, Stuart Blyth on behalf of himself and his partners; and Omar Abdulsalam, CEO of Quartz Energy, acting as the official liaison between both parties.

As the lead organizer in Saudi Arabia, Startime will deliver a fully integrated experience that includes hosting, marketing, coordination with government entities, media management, and premium logistics for international guests; the company will also oversee fan activations such as meet-and-greets, football clinics, and branded sponsor events, ensuring the tour resonates with local audiences and commercial partners alike.

Mr. Shaya Al Kahtani stated: "At Startime, we are proud to contribute to the national movement toward realizing Saudi Vision 2030 by bringing globally celebrated sports experiences to Saudi Arabia; this agreement reflects our commitment to building cultural and athletic bridges between Saudi Arabia and the world, and to empowering international partnerships through innovative, high-impact events"; Mr. Stuart Blyth expressed his enthusiasm, saying: "Our mission is to share the legacy and expertise of football legends with the region and to strengthen the bond between these icons and their passionate Saudi fanbase"; Mr. Omar Abdulsalam added: "It is an honor to be part of this ambitious project, which merges global expertise with Saudi vision and lays the foundation for a sustainable future in the sports events industry”.

This agreement marks a strategic milestone in Saudi Arabia’s journey to redefine the global sports landscape, offering a unified cultural and athletic experience that embodies innovation, openness, and excellence contributing to a thriving sports future in line with the aspirations of the Saudi Arabia wise leadership.
